title: 05-febe-freeform-surface-modeling
summary: Audited the existing sweep/loft/revolve/extrude/patch services and added the missing portable surface workflows: four-sided network, rail revolve, trim/split/untrim/shrink, rebuild/refit/softedit, match/blend/join, offset/normal-extrude, reverse/seam and unroll. Added 16 core tests and 6 OCCT kernel tests plus a measured receipt.

gaps_found: No four-sided curve network, rail revolve, trim/split/untrim/shrink, softedit, surface match/blend, surface offset, reverse/seam or unroll service.
No registered L2-02-05 acceptance test or per-L4 evidence package.
audit_result.gaps_closed: Added crates/om9-core/src/surface_ops.rs, 16 core tests, 6 kernel tests, per-L3 design/fixtures and one receipt per planned L4 role; updated L1/L2/L3 runtime records and the ledger.

remaining: All ten M03-UI surface workflows (selection, preview, commit/cancel, warning) are unsigned.
Network is four-sided Coons; n-sided networks are not implemented.
Match is a boundary-row replacement with a measured angle, not a full optimization.
Seam is a C0 metadata closure, not a true periodic re-parameterization.
Unroll is an average arc-length planar map; exact developable unroll of a doubly curved surface is not claimed.
Portable surface offset is a sampled/refit approximation; exact offset remains the OCCT B-Rep service.
